newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Egis firms after CSFB says maintains 'buy'.
newsitem.headline: Egis firms after CSFB says maintains 'buy'.

text.p: Shares in Egis Gyogyszergyar Rt opened firmer on Monday after CS First Boston said it maintained a 'buy' rating on the stocks of the Hungarian pharmaceuticals company.
Egis shares opened at 10,695 forints, above Friday's close of 10,400 and at 1055 GMT they traded at 10,900 forints.

"The results and the company's partial forecast for 1997 reinforce our view on future earnings development, therefore we have chosen to leave our forecasts unchanged," Spencer Jakab, CSFB's Budapest-based analyst said in a desknote.
Egis released its preliminary 1996 results on Friday and reported Hungarian Accounting Stardards revenues of 24.68 billion forints and a net income of 5.58 billion forints.
